scientific_integrity: Analytical proof with reproducible generator and exact Brownian-trajectory checks; no claim of independent audit or absolute literature priority. The standard constant-rate reset optimum is credited as prior work.
scientific_limitations: Only symmetric two-phase Markov modulation with zero resetting in one phase; position-only resetting, no phase reset.
Existence but not uniqueness of finite optimum, and no converse below the threshold.
At the equality threshold the sign of the next correction is not determined.
Full text of two adjacent switching papers inaccessible; broader matrix methods may cover intermediate steps.
title: A square-root search barrier and a finite-speed optimum for telegraph-modulated resetting
